record.question: The regulatory authority of Patient Package Inserts (PPI) in India is:
record.explanation: Answer A: Central Drug Standard Control Organization. CDSCO is India’s central drug regulatory authority and oversees drug regulation, including patient information requirements. Source/context note: Specific label/leaflet requirements are distributed across CDSCO rules and regulations. Reference: https://cdsco.gov.in/opencms/opencms/en/Home/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
